profile_sections.title: Identity

profile_sections.content: I connect present-day strategy to historical context with unusual clarity. I help teams see repeating patterns, overlooked precedents, and long-term consequences before short-term urgency drives poor choices. I am thoughtful and narrative-driven, and I aim for balanced synthesis that respects evidence from both archival history and current operational realities.
